user.title: Connect Ouflex and import application points
user.description: Automatically read the device-specific Ounet XML via private LAN FTP; do not enter a JSON map unless disabling automatic import. All imported points start read-only.

data.auto_ftp_map: Automatically import all Ouflex points from FTP

write_access.title: Ouflex write access
write_access.description: Controls require an exact map policy and individual physical verification. Imported RW flags alone do not enable writes.

menu_options.refresh_from_ftp: Refresh all points from Ouflex FTP

register_browser.title: Register browser
register_browser.description: Select documented points to create entities. Labels include source address, address base and type. Writes require separate verification.

data.selected_points: Points to add to Home Assistant

register_map.title: Import register map
register_map.description: Paste normalized JSON or the observed Ounet controllertemplate XML. Import disables writes and resets the selection. Site details are discarded.

refresh_from_ftp.title: Refresh Ouflex application map from FTP
refresh_from_ftp.description: Fetch the Ouflex point map directly from its private LAN FTP server. Replaces the current map and selection, and disables all write permissions. No Modbus writes or FTP uploads.

data.confirm: Confirm read-only import of all documented points

error.ftp_import_failed: Could not read or parse the Ouflex FTP application map
